subject: Barry Keoghan

photo.credit: Senior Airman Austin Pate, public domain (US Air Force)

features.label: PALE BLUE EYES
features.chip: light iris, dark lashes: high contrast
features.vo: First, the eyes. Pale blue, framed by dark lashes, so they pop.

features.label: DEEP-SET EYES
features.chip: set deep under a low brow
features.vo: They sit deep under the brow. That is where the stare comes from.

features.label: STRAIGHT DARK BROWS
features.vo: His brows are dark, straight and low. That reads as intense.

features.label: HIGH CHEEKBONES
features.vo: High cheekbones with hollows under them. Every photo gets strong shadows.

features.label: NARROW, SHARP JAW
features.vo: A narrow jaw with a clean angle keeps the whole face lean.

features.label: OFF-CENTRE SMILE
features.vo: And the smile is off-centre. That is what makes him memorable.

card.vo: Put it all together and his face card comes out at 86.

cta.vo: Comment who I should break down next.
